test_title: PYST 14: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Town P is to the east of Town Q. Town Q is to the south of Town R. Town R is to the east of Town S. Town S is to the west of Town T. Town P is to the south-west of Town T. What is the position of Town R with respect to Town T?
solution:
Given:

Town P is to the east of Town Q.

Town Q is to the south of Town R.

Town R is to the east of Town S.

Town S is to the west of Town T.

Town P is to the south-west of Town T. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccd420c7fd980cfd422516f523d90d88409e5b60819c75d9e4adf43ecd7196f7.png] 

Thus, R is to the west of T.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
